contract.intervention_control_relationship: every intervention applied to a treatment is also applied to every baseline it is compared against; enforced by learnability.assert_controlled
contract.null_construction: repeated measurement of the same quantity across at least 8 independent seed blocks; pairwise relative differences form the null
contract.effect_clearing_rule: infometrics.effect_clears_null at the 5th/95th percentile of the measured null, in the pre-declared direction
contract.set_selection_procedure: exhaustive enumeration of all C(K,B) subsets; BEST = argmax mean score, WORST = argmin; no hand-picked sets
contract.budget_derivation: measured mean conjunctive demand size over the attempt-stable pool, rounded; declared before inspecting superadditivity
contract.superadditivity_basis: information, not info/cost; carry cost stored separately
contract.baseline_law_rule: solo baselines measured under the SAME composition law as the mixture they are compared to
contract.liveness_rule: learnability.assert_live must pass before any matched-arm identity comparison

disposition_rules.NEGATIVE: mixtures do not beat the best single component
disposition_rules.NULL: superadditivity does not clear its measured null, OR targeted ablation costs no more than solo value
disposition_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: effect present but not replicated across all attempt seeds, or IX not discharged
disposition_rules.COMPLETE: mixtures beat the best single component AND superadditivity clears its null AND targeted ablation exceeds solo value AND the composition law benefits BEST more than WORST, in every replicate

contract.freeze_rule: once the first organism is evaluated under this attempt_id, no metric, normalisation, control, threshold, set-selection rule, budget, null or verdict criterion may change; a defect voids the verdict and opens a new attempt_id

_freeze_rule: no criterion may change under this attempt_id once the first organism is evaluated; a defect voids the verdict and opens a new attempt_id
